purpose: Establish the poisoned Yamuna: toxic fumes rise, a bird falls dead, cows collapse at the bank.

beats.acting: violet-green fume rises from the river, billowing upward
a bird in the sky drops from the air, wings limp
cows at the bank stagger and fall, tongues lolling
the fume spreads across the water surface, water turns violet-green

camera.move: tilt down from sky to river

light.key: dull morning sun from screen left

compositing.generated: fume animation, bird fall, cow collapse
compositing.post: on-2s hold at end, color grade to violet-grey

start_state: Lush green riverbank, clear blue water, cows grazing
end_state: Violet-green water, black ash-sand bank, dead bird in foreground, cows collapsed
sound: wind, bird wing flap, thud, cow lowing (muffled)

purpose: Close-up on the black sand bank, dead roots, and a collapsed cow, emphasizing the scorched earth.

beats.acting: camera pans across black ash-sand, dry dead roots
a dead cow lies on its side, tongue out, eyes glazed
violet-green water laps at the black bank, small bubbles

start_state: Black ash-sand, dry roots, a cow carcass
end_state: Same, water lapping at the edge
